articles.summary: 24/7 Wall St.: DA Davidson Upgrades Rivian From Underperform — Here’s What Still Has to Go Right. DA Davidson has upgraded Rivian Automotive (NASDAQ: RIVN) to Neutral from Underperform, citing valuation after a sharp pullback in the stock. The firm kept its price target unchanged at $14, signaling a more cautious form of optimism rather than outright bullishness. articles.title: Rivian R2 Takes 2026 Electric Green Car of the Year; Lexus, Jeep, Ford, and Bintelli Round Out Winners
articles.mainIdea: Rivian R2 Takes 2026 Electric Green Car of the Year; Lexus, Jeep, Ford, and Bintelli Round Out Winners
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Rivian R2 Takes 2026 Electric Green Car of the Year; Lexus, Jeep, Ford, and Bintelli Round Out Winners. Green Car Journal has announced the second round of its 2026 Green Car Awards™, with the Rivian R2 taking 2026 Electric Green Car of the Year™. Presented since 2005 and widely recognized as the most important environmental awards in the automotive field, the Green Car Awards™ highlight models that stand out for their environmental performance, advanced technology, and leadership in moving toward a more sustainable driving future. Related tickers mentioned: F.
